title: Beef Empanada Koftas
description: A twist on traditional koftas, made with beef empanada filling, inspired by Indian flavors and techniques.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground beef empanada filling, chopped onion, grated ginger, garam masala, cumin, cayenne pepper, and salt. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Divide the mixture into 8 equal parts and shape each part into a ball.
Flatten each ball slightly into an oval shape.
Thread a wooden skewer through the center of each kofta, leaving a small space between each.
Brush the koftas with lemon juice and cook for 6-8 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve hot with chopped cilantro and your favorite chutney.
Note: If using wooden skewers, make sure to soak them in water for 30 minutes before grilling to prevent burning.
